reason: A browser-side editing utility that improves Markdown list continuation, indentation, outdentation, and automatic numbering in the DSH web input box without network, file, credential, or persistent data access.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 网页输入框提供 Markdown 列表续行、缩进、反缩进和自动编号功能的浏览器端编辑辅助插件。
summaries.en: A browser-side editing helper that adds Markdown list continuation, indentation, outdentation, and automatic renumbering to the DSH web input box.

capabilities: Enhances Markdown list editing in a web textarea
Handles keyboard shortcuts for list continuation, indentation, outdentation, and renumbering
Reads and modifies only the current in-memory draft text in the input field
